definitions.explanation: A count of three people, using the Sino-Japanese number with the counter for people.

examples.english: The three of us will go.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{三人|さんにん}います。
{三人|さんにん}の{学生|がくせい}がこの{問題|もんだい}に{答|こた}えた。

notes:
COUNTING PEOPLE:
The counter {人|にん} is used for counting people. The readings for one and two people are irregular: {一人|ひとり}, {二人|ふたり}. From three onward, the Sino-Japanese system is used: {三人|さんにん}, {四人|よにん}, {五人|ごにん}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{三人|さんにん}で (as a group of three)
・{三人|さんにん}とも (all three people)
・{三人|さんにん}{兄弟|きょうだい} (three siblings)
